periods: Through 2024 fit. 2025 H1 calibrates probability. 2025 H2 chooses model and alert cutoffs. H1 2026 is evaluated after all choices.
selection: Highest Kp >=5 recall under a 5% false positive rate on 2025 H2, then lower Kp >=5 Brier score.
truth: Full native three-hour Kp/ap bins beginning at or after a simulated data receipt and ending by +6h.
fallback: When minute inputs are insufficient, use the scheduled Kp/ap distribution.
state_control: Same training and calibration protocol with only known Kp/Dst and lead. Keep the same input coverage as the fast arm.
weights: One release and target per UTC bin, using the latest qualifying blind trigger. No ETA or verified arrival feature.
calibration: One monotone logistic map across all 27 ordinal exceedance probabilities. Derive ap from the same ordinal distribution.
